articles.title: Giant Stone Jars in Laos Weren't for Rice Wine—They Were Ancient Tombs!
articles.summary: Thousands of huge stone jars in Laos were a mystery for years. Now, a jar with bones from 37 people shows they were used for burials, not for storing food or wine.

articles.title: Light and Magnets Team Up in Super-Thin Materials!
articles.summary: Scientists found a way to make light and magnetism work together in materials only a few atoms thick. This could lead to super-fast computers and new quantum gadgets.

articles.title: A Super-Loud Space Rumble Gives Us a Peek Inside a Black Hole's Edge!
articles.summary: Scientists heard an extra-loud gravitational wave from two black holes crashing. It let them measure the spinning edge of the final black hole for the first time.
